stories.headline: WTI Drops Below $90 (-2%) While War Escalates Across 3 Fronts — Most Contradictory Signal in Markets Today
stories.thesis: Oil collapsing 2% while Iran tolls Hormuz ($1.5-2M/ship), Israel auto-triggers Beirut strikes, and Ben-Gvir floats civilian abduction. Markets pricing demand destruction over supply risk. ADP +29K confirms stagflation. This is a binary resolution point: Hezbollah rocket = $95+, sub-$88 = demand collapse.

stories.headline: US ADP +29K — Labor Market Cracking as Inflation Expectations Rise 3rd Month. Stagflation Confirmed.
stories.thesis: ADP printed +29K jobs, well below prior +35.7K. US 1-year consumer inflation expectations rose 3rd straight month. Textbook stagflation: weakening labor + sticky inflation = Fed trapped. First hard data point confirming stagflation thesis.

stories.headline: Israeli Minister Ben-Gvir Urges Cabinet to Abduct Lebanese Civilians — Far-Right Escalation Signal
stories.thesis: Ben-Gvir proposed abducting Lebanese women and children as psychological warfare against Hezbollah — in a cabinet session, not a tweet. Combined with automatic Beirut strike trigger, the escalation floor with Lebanon has structurally risen. Raises probability of Hezbollah rocket trigger firing.

stories.headline: EU Proposes Biggest Sanctions Package in 2 Years — 90 Banks, 11 Crypto Platforms, LNG Tanker Ban
stories.thesis: EU targets 90 banks, 11 crypto platforms, LNG tanker ban, 170+ sanctioned positions. Structural tightening of Russia's financial isolation. Crypto ban may accelerate Russian BTC demand as capital flight into non-sanctionable assets.

stories.headline: BlackRock Transferring BTC to Exchanges for Client Sales — Distribution Signal Beneath the Surface
stories.thesis: BlackRock routing BTC to exchanges likely means ETF/OTC desks filling sell orders. Real supply hitting order books. Short-term BTC bearish — institutions sell into strength, retail panics. $58K support is key level.
